messages:
maya: quick sync — shaping Q3 hosted roadmap for embeddings + rerank. need a short playbook, owners, canary metrics. thoughts?
sam: high level: prioritize latency and unit cost for embeddings. customers are calling for ~20-40ms p95 on single-row and ~2x lower unit cost vs today.
devon: we have two experiments lined up: 8-bit quant kernels and KV prefix caching. both reduce cost; quant helps memory, cache helps tokens/req.
maya: @devon can you run back-of-envelope perf + cost estimates for p4d and a100? numbers by EOD fri would be great.
devon: yes. rough initial: 8-bit -> memory 2x lower, per-token compute ~30% lower; KV cache -> effective tokens/req drop ~35-45% on our sample workloads. will quantify.
oliver: rerank angle: run candidate scoring in batched mode and fall back to smaller lightweight scorer for filtering. should keep top-5 quality within ~1% if tuned.
sasha: propose concrete launch criteria we can agree to: (1) embeddings p95 <= 40ms single-row on A100, (2) rerank sustained throughput >= 500 qps on reserved nodes, (3) cost/unit <= $0.0006 for typical 512-d embed, (4) quality regression <= 1% on our eval sets.
maya: agree to those. add canary rules: 2 customers in different regions, 7-day ramp at 5% traffic, auto rollback triggers: >5% error rate or >15% latency regression.
sam: infra dependency: need per-route token cost + tracing in console before canary. who owns that?
devon: @oliver can you take canary infra? i’ll own model variant selection and perf tuning.
oliver: i can own canary infra. will need feature-flag plumbing + rollout-service changes. ETA ~2w to prep infra hooks.
sasha: risk note: quantization can shift embedding norms. need eval harness and monitoring thresholds for drift (cosine drop).
maya: action items: dev perf numbers (devon), canary plan doc (oliver), pricing simulation (sam), eval suite & alerts (sasha). target: start canary early august if green.
sam: customer picks for canary: Acme Analytics (embeds-heavy), BetaAI (rerank-heavy), plus EduSearch as a broader test. recommend Acme + BetaAI as primary.
maya: +1. i’ll loop in solutions & privacy for prompts and data handling.
tanya-bot: deploy-bot: created feature flag hosted-embed-rerank-canary (id: ff-2024-17235)
maya: thanks. last housekeeping: draft release notes and SLA addendum now so sales/legal can review. put a short doc in product drive and link from canary plan.
oliver: creating PR with rollout checklist and drive link in 24h.
maya: weekly sync established: tuesdays 11am, calendar invite coming. if anything urgent ping me in #eng-oncall.
maya: thanks team — small increments, measure, iterate.
